rows.said: Haan didi, main ready hoon. Mujhe lagta hai dabbe mein zyada corners hote hain.
rows.heard: हाँ दीदी, मैं ready हूँ। मुझे लगता है डब्बे में ज्यादा corners होते हैं।
rows.reply: Aarav, dabbe ka ek flat face socho—tumhare hisaab se face kya hota hai? Golu ko bhi tum sikhaoge.

rows.said: Achha, toh dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, तो डब्बे की flat side को face कहते हैं?
rows.reply: Haan Aarav, dabbe ki har flat side face hoti hai. Do faces jahan milte hain, woh edge; milne ki jagah corner. Whiteboard par dabbe mein kitne corners ginoge?

rows.said: Haan, samajh gaya. Do faces jahan milte hain woh edge hai.
rows.heard: हाँ, समझ गया। दो faces जहाँ मिलते हैं, वो edge है।
rows.reply: Bilkul, tumne edge ka rule sahi bataya. Matchbox ek cuboid hai; ab uske faces ginne ka agla tareeka kya hoga?

rows.said: Achha, aur corner woh point hai na jahan edges milte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, और कॉर्नर वो पॉइंट है न, जहाँ edges मिलते हैं?
rows.reply: Haan Aarav, corner woh point hai jahan edges milte hain. Matchbox ke upar kitne corners dikh rahe hain?

rows.said: Achha, toh dabbe ki flat side ko face kehte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, तो डब्बे की flat side को face कहते हैं?
rows.reply: Haan Aarav, flat sides faces hoti hain. Cube mein chhupe hue faces bhi milaakar total kitne faces honge?

rows.said: Haan, samajh gaya. Do faces jahan milte hain woh edge hai.
rows.heard: हाँ, समांज गया। दो faces जहाँ मिलते हैं वो edge है।
rows.reply: Aarav, tumne edge ka rule phir se sahi pakda. Ab dice aur biscuit box mein faces gin kar batao—kisme zyada hain?

rows.said: Kyunki maine har taraf gina, upar neeche, aage peeche, daayen baayen.
rows.heard: क्योंकि मैंने हर तरफ गिना। ऊपर नीचे, आगे पीछे, दाएँ बाएँ।
rows.reply: Aarav, tumne opposite sides jodkar poora tareeka dikhaya. Dice ek cube hota hai. Iske kitne flat faces hain?

rows.reply: Aarav, tumne “ten” kaha. Dice ke faces phir se gino: upar, neeche, aage, peeche, daaye, baaye—kitne?
Aarav, tumne ek-ek side ginne ki koshish ki. Dice ke upar, neeche, aage, peeche, daaye, baaye—phir se bolo, kitne faces?

rows.said: Mujhe lagta hai dice ke chhe faces hain.
rows.heard: मुझे लगता है, डायस के छे फेसेस हैं।
rows.reply: Haan Aarav, 6 faces. Tumne chhe directions gin kar answer nikala. Ab 6 faces ko opposite pairs mein kaise baantoge?

rows.said: Kyunki maine har taraf gina, upar neeche, aage peeche, daayen baayen.
rows.heard: क्योंकि मैंने हर तरफ गिना। ऊपर नीचे, आगे पीछे, दाएं बाएं।
rows.reply: Bilkul Aarav, tumne teen opposite pairs gine: upar-neeche, aage-peeche, daaye-baaye. Dice ki picture dekho. Tumhe 3 faces dikh rahe hain. Poore dice mein total kitne faces hain?
Theek hai Aarav, tumne bas apna tareeka bataya tha. Ab choice chuno: 3, 6, ya 12?
